# label_clusters_frequency { #dyf.label_clusters_frequency }

```python
label_clusters_frequency(titles, labels)
```

Label clusters using TF-IDF token frequency (no LLM).

Per-cluster TF-IDF: tokens frequent in one cluster but rare globally win.
Falls back to raw title frequency if tokenization yields nothing
(e.g. numeric-only titles like "Digit 7"). Disambiguates identical
labels across clusters with ``(2)``, ``(3)`` suffixes.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                     | Description                                         | Default    |
|--------|------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|------------|
| titles | [list](`list`)\[[str](`str`)\]           | List of title strings, one per item.                | _required_ |
| labels | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | Integer cluster assignments, same length as titles. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                         | Description                              |
|--------|----------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------|
|        | [dict](`dict`)\[[int](`int`), [str](`str`)\] | dict mapping cluster_id -> label string. |
